definitions.explanation: An artificial waterway constructed for navigation, irrigation, or water supply.

examples.japanese: パナマ{運河|うんが}は{太平洋|たいへいよう}と{大西洋|たいせいよう}を{結|むす}んでいる。
examples.english: The Panama Canal connects the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans.

examples.japanese: {運河|うんが}を{船|ふね}が{通|とお}る。
この{運河|うんが}は{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}に{作|つく}られた。
examples.english: This canal was built during the Edo period.

notes:
USAGE: Refers to artificial waterways, as opposed to natural rivers.

FAMOUS CANALS:
・パナマ{運河|うんが} (Panama Canal)
・スエズ{運河|うんが} (Suez Canal)
・{小樽|おたる}{運河|うんが} (Otaru Canal - famous tourist spot in Hokkaido)

IN JAPAN: Many historical canals were built for transporting goods, especially during the Edo period. Some have been preserved as scenic spots.

RELATED:
・{水路|すいろ} (waterway, channel)
・{川|かわ} (river - natural)
